notes_for_editor: The only source on the Doogan tower itself is one MTB Project photo title (2018, near Chatsworth); the link between the photo's 'Doogan Lookout' and the tnlandforms doogan mtn point is by name and location, not confirmed. Elevation read as feet (list gives no unit). Two searches and the caches gave no build, staffing, removal or access source. The MTB breadcrumb files the photo under Chattahoochee National Forest; not verified. The NHLR Murray Fire Tower (Fort Mountain, about 23 km south) is a separate site. The nearby Doogan Tower Road listed on the MTB page is in Benton, Tennessee, a different place; do not link it. Do not encourage visits: no access information found.
